guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The Dockerfile build fails at the command `update-alternatives --install /usr/bin/python3 python3 /usr/bin/python3 1` with error: 'update-alternatives: <link> and <path> can't be the same.' This error occurs because the command attempts to create an alternative for python3 pointing to the same path (/usr/bin/python3), which is not allowed. This step is redundant and unnecessary since Ubuntu 22.04 already includes python3 at /usr/bin/python3. To fix this, remove or comment out the line `RUN update-alternatives --install /usr/bin/python3 python3 /usr/bin/python3 1` from the Dockerfile. After this fix, the Dockerfile build should proceed successfully, enabling environment setup for test execution.
